summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; nothing was run. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative DFS with explicit stack, 4 cells per level) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py constrains Align's render width to the measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width), adds Align.__repr__, and adds VerticalCenter (render, measure, repr, JupyterMixin). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in the render options used for collected renderables in print. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as unreleased, keeps the existing markdown entry, and adds an Added subheading with the two entries. tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, render, and measure tests; tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a test expecting Measurement(11, 19) for the acceptance tree. Nothing was committed. No tests were run, so all results are unverified.
